channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Multiple dead in explosion during live-fire military training exercise
item.description: Multiple people were killed and dozens injured when an explosion occurred at a Canadian military base, according to authorities.

item.title: Rep. Turner seeks congressional inquiry into Starlink disruptions
item.description: Ohio GOP Rep. Mike Turner has called for a congressional investigation into disruptions of Starlink satellite communications in Ukraine.

item.title: Pope Leo plans to resume activities after cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday, a day after leaving the hospital following cancer surgery.

item.title: CBS News poll: Talarico-Paxton Senate race a Texas toss-up
item.description: Turnout will be crucial as Texans cite cost of living concerns in the Senate race between Ken Paxton and James Talarico.
